steps.command:
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
as_root() {
  if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
    "$@"
  else
    sudo -n "$@"
  fi
}
cat <<'SCRIPT' | as_root tee /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker > /dev/null
#!/bin/sh
trap 'exit 0' TERM INT
while :; do sleep 30; done
SCRIPT
as_root chown root:root /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
as_root chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
